title: pytest <file> fails collection: No module named 'tests'
detail: Running a single test module by path, e.g. '.venv/bin/pytest tests/test_effort.py' or tests/test_phases.py, fails collection with ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'tests', from 'from tests._common import ...'. Bare 'pytest' (1652 collected) and 'python -m pytest <file>' (which puts cwd on sys.path) both work. A normal invocation of the suite failing is a product defect. The likely fix is rootdir/pythonpath config in pyproject (pytest 'pythonpath = ["."]') or relative imports. Surfaced by the measured-token-usage conventions-enforcer.
